summary: always notice first firefly She tucks into blades of grass lone beacon of life Happens every summer On somedayish But it's the second where magic dances Third and fourth follow Light falling up in reverse meteors orbiting my soul bouncing between me and heaven and earth. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
always notice first firefly
She tucks into
blades of grass
lone beacon of life
Happens every summer
On somedayish

But it's the second
where magic dances
Third and fourth follow
Light falling up
in reverse meteors
orbiting my soul
bouncing between me
and heaven and earth.
#smallpoems
